## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(simling)
```

## The data

`rhythm_metrics` comes from a simulated study of speech rhythm. Eight speakers of each of six languages read sentences, told a story and spoke freely, and each of the 1200 speech samples has two measures we use today: the speech rate (`rate`, in syllables per second) and ΔC (`delta_c`, in ms). ΔC is the standard deviation of the durations of the consonant intervals in a sample, one of the [rhythm metrics]{.hl} that phoneticians use to compare languages.

```{r}
glimpse(rhythm_metrics)
```

Today's question: does ΔC change with speech rate?

---

### 3.4 Bonus: R² by hand
